## How to use this manual

Use this manual when you need to run, check or repair the BNR analytical and
publishing system. Start with the section above that matches your task.

| Manual | Main question answered |
|---|---|
| **Public Methods Manual** | What does a statistic mean, and how should I interpret it? |
| **[Operations Manual](../operations/index.qmd)** | What must BNR staff do, who decides and what evidence is retained? |
| **Technical Manual** | How do I run and maintain the system? |

The analytical workflows create and approve results in Stata. Quarto presents
those approved results; it must not recalculate or silently change them.
